description:
## Problem
`metadata.py:551-566` issues `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS …` on every platform except ClickHouse and BigQuery. It is unsupported on Snowflake standard tables, Databricks/Delta, Redshift, Trino/Presto/Athena, Spark SQL and DataFusion (observed: "Unsupported logical plan: CreateIndex"). T-SQL has no `IF NOT EXISTS` index form.

Other gaps:
- `clickhouse-cloud` is missing from the ClickHouse DDL branch (`metadata.py:540`).
- BigQuery keeps `VARCHAR(255)`.
- Table and index creation share one try (`:495-510`), so an index failure marks creation failed. The failure is swallowed into "⚠️ Failed to save tuning metadata", and reuse and drift detection silently never work.

## Change
- Move metadata DDL per dialect into the registry or a per-adapter `metadata_store_ddl()`.
- No index where secondary indexes are unsupported.
- T-SQL uses `IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT … sys.indexes) CREATE INDEX`.
- Add `clickhouse-cloud` to the ClickHouse branch.
- BigQuery uses `STRING`/`INT64`/`TIMESTAMP`.
- Athena uses Iceberg with an explicit location, or declares metadata unsupported with a clear message.
- Separate table creation from index creation.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- A metadata failure stays non-fatal, but is loud and accurate.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
- This item touches paths listed in the soundness manifest by `tuning-trust-paths-soundness-manifest-20261001`. The PR needs an external `Soundness review:` section (AGENTS.md) and must not auto-merge.
